title: Agent workspace app: handoff context, guided resolution and agent assist
scenario: LFG embeds a third-party app in the Connect agent workspace that shows the Lex bot's handoff context, a guided checklist per intent and ranked knowledge suggestions, and resolves the ServiceNow incident through a backend. The prototype leaked the previous caller's context, crashed on bad slot JSON, showed Executive Office procedures to contractors, duplicated articles and hid backend failures.
task: Render handoff context from only the handoff contact attributes, robust to bad slot JSON
Correct connected/cleared semantics with chat concurrency and unmount cleanup
Checklist per intent with verified pre-checks and required-step gating
Rank agent-assist and Bedrock KB suggestions: dedupe, entitlement, floor, order, cap
Backend PATCH with auth, validation and visible failure handling
acceptance: Never requests all attributes; no unrelated attribute rendered
Clears only the contact on screen; new contact resets the checklist
Resolve gated on required steps; failure shown and retryable
Ranking rules and backend client behavior pass the hidden suite
